title: Cisco security advisory (AV26-1020)
description: As of October 7, 2026, Cisco is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products:
products:
Cisco Nexus 3000 Series Switches
	Multiple versions and models

Cisco Nexus 9000 Series Switches
	Multiple versions and models

UCS 6300 Series Fabric Interconnect
	Prior to 4.3(6.260049)

Meraki Campus Gateways
	Prior to 32.2.5 (late Oct 2026)
Prior to 33.1.4 (mid-Nov 2026)

Meraki MG Cellular Gateways
	Prior to 26.1.4

Meraki MR Wireless Access Points
	Multiple versions

Meraki MS Series Switches
	Multiple Versions

Meraki MV Smart Cameras
	Prior to 8.0

Meraki MX Security and SD-WAN Appliances
	Multiples versions

Cisco License On-Prem Release
	Prior to 10-202609

Cisco NX-OS Software Release
	Multiples versions

Cisco UCS Software Release
	Prior to 4.3(6.260049)
Prior to 4.3(6.260059)
Prior to 6.0(2.260080)

Cisco Application Policy Infrastructure Controller (APIC)
	Prior to 6.0(9h)
Prior to 6.1(6g)
Prior to 6.2(3g)

Cisco Finesse Release
	Prior to 15.0(1) SU3 (Feb 2027)

Cisco Packaged CCE and Unified CCE Release
	Prior to 15.0(1)ES202701 (Jan 2027)

Cisco Unified CCX Release
	Prior to 15.0(1) SU2 (Feb 2027)
solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
